/*selectMasterMpIfOrderCreateList*/
SELECT IFS.STATUS
, IFS.IF_STATUS /* 상태(IF) */ , IFS.PO_STATUS /* 상태(PO) */ , IFS.IF_EXCEL /* 상태(IF) */ , IFS.PO_EXCEL /* 상태(PO) */
, IFS.ERROR_MSG , IFS.BUYER_NAME /* 고객사명 */ , IFS.BUYER /* 고객사코드(Hidden) */ , IFS.LEGACY_PO_NO /* 주문번호 */ , IFS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ /* 주문항번 */ , IFS.LEGACY_PR_NO /* 관리번호 */ , IFS.BUYER_ITEM_NO /* 품목코드 */ , IFS.BUYER_ITEM_ERR_FLAG , IFS.DESCRIPTION /* 품목명 */ , IFS.SPECIFICATION /* 규격 */ , IFS.UNIT_MEASURE /* 단위 */ , IFS.ITEM_QTY /* IF수량 */ , IFS.UNIT_PRICE_IF /* IF단가 */ , IFS.UNIT_PRICE_PO /* 발주단가 */ , IFS.LIST_PRICE , IFS.ITEM_AMT , IFS.LIST_AMT , IFS.AGENT /* 협력사코드(Hidden) */ , IFS.AGENT_NAME /* 협력사명 */ , IFS.BUDGET_DEPT_CODE /* 예산부서코드 */ , IFS.BUDGET_DEPT_NAME /* 예산부서명 */ , IFS.BUDGET_DEPT_ERR_FLAG , IFS.BUDGET_ACCOUNT_CODE /* 예산계정코드 */ , IFS.BUDGET_ACCOUNT_NAME /* 예산계정명 */ , IFS.BUDGET_ACCOUNT_ERR_FLAG , IFS.PURCHASER_USER_ID /* 발주자ID */ , IFS.PURCHASER_USER_ID_ERR_FLAG /* 발주자에러플래그 */ , IFS.PURCHASER_USER_NAME /* 발주자명 */ , IFS.DELY_TO_LOCATION /* 도착지코드 */ , IFS.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT /* 도착지명 */ , IFS.PO_DATE /* 발주일 */ , IFS.RD_DATE /* 납기예정일 */ , IFS.REQ_USER_INFO /* 요청자정보 */ , IFS.COMORG_CODE , IFS.CONTRACT_NO , IFS.CONTRACT_SEQ , IFS.PURCHASER_DEPT , IFS.REMARK , IFS.CURRENCY_CODE
FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'N' THEN '0' WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'T' THEN '1' WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' THEN '2' END AS STATUS /* 상태 */ , A.ERROR_MSG , A.BUYER , J.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NAME , A.LEGACY_PO_NO , A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , A.LEGACY_PR_NO , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , DECODE(NVL(A.CONTRACT_NO,' '),' ','Y','N') AS BUYER_ITEM_ERR_FLAG , I.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION , I.SPECIFICATION , A.UNIT_MEASURE , A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE_IF , D.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE_PO , A.ITEM_QTY , A.UNIT_PRICE * A.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_AMT , D.LIST_PRICE , D.LIST_PRICE * A.ITEM_QTY AS LIST_AMT , A.CONTRACT_NO , A.CONTRACT_SEQ , A.PURCHASER_USER_ID , NVL(L.USER_NAME_LOC,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_NAME , NVL(L.DEPARTMENT,' ') AS PURCHASER_DEPT , CASE WHEN TRIM(L.USER_ID) IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PURCHASER_USER_ID_ERR_FLAG , A.DELY_TO_LOCATION , A.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , A.BUDGET_DEPT AS BUDGET_DEPT_CODE , M.TEXT1 AS BUDGET_DEPT_NAME , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.BUDGET_DEPT) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(M.TEXT1) IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BUDGET_DEPT_ERR_FLAG , A.BUDGET_ACCOUNT AS BUDGET_ACCOUNT_CODE , N.TEXT1 AS BUDGET_ACCOUNT_NAME , CASE WHEN TRIM(A.BUDGET_ACCOUNT) IS NOT NULL AND N.TEXT1 IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BUDGET_ACCOUNT_ERR_FLAG , A.PO_DATE , A.RD_DATE , A.REQ_USER_INFO , A.REMARK , A.IF_FLAG , A.IF_DATM , A.ADD_USER_ID , A.AGENT , F.COM_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_NAME , A.COMORG_CODE , A.CUR AS CURRENCY_CODE , CASE WHEN O.STATUS = 'C' THEN '3' WHEN O.STATUS = 'R' THEN '4' WHEN O.STATUS = 'D' THEN '5' ELSE '6' END AS IF_STATUS /* IF상태 */ , CASE WHEN P.STATUS = 'C' THEN '3' WHEN P.STATUS = 'R' THEN '4' WHEN P.STATUS = 'D' THEN '5' ELSE '6' END AS PO_STATUS /* PO상태 */ , O.STATUS AS IF_EXCEL , P.STATUS AS PO_EXCEL FROM IF_PODT_EXUP A /* 인터페이스 주문상세내역 */ INNER JOIN ( SELECT /*+INDEX(MIS_BUYER_MNG SYS_C0052925)*/ DISTINCT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG /* 고객사별 담당자 정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_DEPT = #{st_user_dept} ) K ON (K.BUYER = A.BUYER) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCQDT D /* 구매사별 계약서 가격정보 */ ON (D.BUYER = A.COMORG_CODE AND D.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND D.CONTRACT_NO = A.CONTRACT_NO AND D.CONTRACT_SEQ = A.CONTRACT_SEQ AND D.AGENT = A.AGENT ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 E /* 회사별 코드관리 */ ON (E.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND E.TYPE = 'C012' AND E.CODE = A.DELY_TO_LOCATION ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCMPY F /* 협력사정보 */ ON (F.COM_CODE = A.AGENT) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD1 H /* 마스터 코드관리 */ ON (H.TYPE = 'M034' AND H.CODE = D.PROCESS_TYPE AND H.FLAG = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMBYIT I /* 구매사카탈로그 상품정보 */ ON (I.BUYER = A.COMORG_CODE AND I.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCMPY J /* 회원사정보 */ ON (J.COM_CODE = A.BUYER ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMLUSR L /* 발주자 정보 */ ON (L.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND L.USER_ID = A.PURCHASER_USER_ID AND L.STATUS != 'D') LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 M /* 예산부서 */ ON (M.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND M.TYPE = 'C001' AND M.CODE = A.BUDGET_DEPT) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 N /* 예산계정 */ ON (N.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND N.TYPE = 'Z014' AND N.CODE = A.BUDGET_ACCOUNT) LEFT OUTER JOIN IF_PODT O ON (O.BUYER = A.BUYER AND O.LEGACY_PO_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND O.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND O.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMPODT P /* 발주 제품정보 */ ON (P.BUYER = A.BUYER AND P.LEGACY_PO_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND P.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.IF_FLAG <> 'D'
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.DOC_TYPE = 'CREATE'
AND A.IF_FLAG = 'E'
AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
AND A.IF_FLAG IN ('N','E','T')
ORDER BY A.BUYER , A.LEGACY_PO_NO , A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) IFS

/*getMasterMpIfOrderCreateErrorCount*/
SELECT NVL(COUNT(IF_FLAG),'0') AS CNT FROM IF_PODT_EXUP WHERE 1=1 AND BUYER = #{BUYER} AND ADD_USER_ID = NVL(#{st_user_id},' ') AND IF_FLAG = 'E' AND DOC_TYPE = 'CREATE'

/*getMasterMpIfOrderCreateItemInfo*/
SELECT NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(AGENT,' ') AS AGENT, NVL(CONTRACT_NO,' ') AS CONTRACT_NO, NVL(CONTRACT_SEQ,' ') AS CONTRACT_SEQ, NVL(BUYER,' ') AS COMORG_CODE, NVL(PROCESS_TYPE,' ') AS PROCESS_TYPE, NVL(UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM V_KEPBYIT WHERE COM_CODE = NVL(trim(#{BUYER}),' ') AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = NVL(trim(#{BUYER_ITEM_NO}),' ') AND PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG in ('N','T','A')

/*getMasterMpIfOrderCreateErrCount*/
SELECT DECODE(NVL(A.CONTRACT_NO,' '),' ','Y','N') AS BUYER_ITEM_ERR_FLAG , CASE WHEN TRIM(L.USER_ID) IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PURCHASER_USER_ID_ERR_FLAG , CASE WHEN M.TEXT1 IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BUDGET_DEPT_ERR_FLAG , CASE WHEN N.TEXT1 IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BUDGET_ACCOUNT_ERR_FLAG , CASE WHEN A.CUR = 'KRW' THEN ( CASE WHEN NVL(A.UNIT_PRICE,0) != NVL(D.UNIT_PRICE,0) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) ELSE 'N' END AS UNIT_PRICE_ERR_FLAG FROM IF_PODT_EXUP A /* 인터페이스 주문상세내역 */ INNER JOIN ( SELECT /*+INDEX(MIS_BUYER_MNG SYS_C0052925)*/ DISTINCT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG /* 고객사별 담당자 정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_DEPT = #{st_user_dept} ) K ON (K.BUYER = A.BUYER) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCQDT D /* 구매사별 계약서 가격정보 */ ON (D.BUYER = A.COMORG_CODE AND D.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND D.CONTRACT_NO = A.CONTRACT_NO AND D.CONTRACT_SEQ = A.CONTRACT_SEQ AND D.AGENT = A.AGENT AND D.STATUS != 'D' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMLUSR L /* 발주자 정보 */ ON (L.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND L.USER_ID = A.PURCHASER_USER_ID AND L.STATUS != 'D') LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 M /* 예산부서 */ ON (M.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND M.TYPE = 'C001' AND M.CODE = A.BUDGET_DEPT) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCOD2 N /* 예산계정 */ ON (N.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND N.TYPE = 'Z014' AND N.CODE = A.BUDGET_ACCOUNT) WHERE 1=1 AND A.IF_FLAG <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND A.ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND LEGACY_PO_NO = NVL(#{LEGACY_PO_NO},' ') AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = NVL(#{LEGACY_PO_SEQ},' ') AND A.IF_FLAG IN ('N','E') AND A.DOC_TYPE = 'CREATE' ORDER BY A.BUYER , A.LEGACY_PO_NO , A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
mapper.update: /*saveMasterMpIfOrderCreate*/ INSERT INTO IF_PODT_EXUP (BUYER, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, LEGACY_PR_NO, STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO, UNIT_MEASURE, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, ITEM_AMT , BUDGET_DEPT, PURCHASER_USER_ID, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ , DELY_TO_LOCATION, DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , PO_DATE, RD_DATE, REQ_USER_INFO, REMARK , IF_FLAG, ADD_USER_ID, BUDGET_ACCOUNT, COMORG_CODE, AGENT, CUR) VALUES( UPPER(TRIM(#{BUYER})), TRIM(#{LEGACY_PO_NO}), TRIM(#{LEGACY_PO_SEQ}), TRIM(#{LEGACY_PR_NO}), 'C', UPPER(TRIM(#{BUYER_ITEM_NO})), UPPER(TRIM(#{UNIT_MEASURE})), NVL(#{UNIT_PRICE_IF},0), NVL(#{ITEM_QTY},0), (NVL(#{UNIT_PRICE_IF},0)*NVL(#{ITEM_QTY},0)), TRIM(#{BUDGET_DEPT_CODE}), UPPER(TRIM(#{PURCHASER_USER_ID})), UPPER(#{CONTRACT_NO}), UPPER(#{CONTRACT_SEQ}), DECODE(#{D_CHK},'N',TRIM(#{DELY_TO_LOCATION}),'ZZZZ'), DECODE(#{D_CHK},'N',(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C012' AND CODE = #{DELY_TO_LOCATION} AND COMPANY_CODE = TRIM(#{BUYER})),TRIM(#{DELY_TO_LOCATION})), UPPER(#{PO_DATE}), UPPER(#{RD_DATE}), TRIM(#{REQ_USER_INFO}),TRIM(#{REMARK}), 'N', UPPER(TRIM(#{st_user_id})), UPPER(#{BUDGET_ACCOUNT_CODE}), #{COMORG_CODE}, #{AGENT}, NVL(#{CURRENCY_CODE},'KRW'))
